entries.name: Carol Ruth Silver

expected.charges: Freedom Ride participation — arrested Jackson, June 7, 1961.
expected.convicted: Convicted June 8, 1961 of breach of the peace
expected.sentence: Sentenced June 8, 1961 to four months, with two months suspended, and a $200 fine. Held at Hinds County Jail and transferred to Parchman June 23. Released in July 1961; exact discharge day remains unresolved because the archival finding aid gives July 14 while the published diary is described as forty days of custody.

updates.sentence: Sentenced June 8, 1961 to four months, two suspended, and $200. Transferred to Parchman June 23. Diary records release July 15; archival finding aid instead gives July 14.

entries.rationale: Prefer dated diary release account (July 15) over archival summary (July 14). Do not infer an endpoint from rounded forty-day descriptions.
